description: Errant SHA-256 hashes recorded for production weights and centroids in phase_04db git_baseline_and_preservation.md, conflicting with actual disk bytes.
root_cause: Manual copy-paste / placeholder insertion into narrative documentation.
remediation: Documented exact byte identity across all Git commits and manifests in checkpoint_hash_reconciliation.csv.

description: Phase 4D-C report stated development=19, validation=7, test=5 (sum=31), whereas manifest contained dev=18, val=9, test=5 (sum=32).
root_cause: Typographical error in narrative report synthesis.
remediation: Reconciled exact counts (18 dev, 9 val, 5 test = 32 parents) with automated mathematical invariant verification.

description: Protocol hash manifest and protocol markdown were generated by reporting script after evaluating test cases.
root_cause: Automated single-script pipeline co-generation without prior cryptographic pre-registration freeze.
remediation: Reclassified study as EXECUTION_REPEATED_WITH_FROZEN_CONFIGURATION / exploratory source-disjoint pilot; withdrew confirmatory trial claims.

description: SEC EDGAR Exhibit 10 contracts labeled as PUBLIC_DOMAIN_US_FEDERAL_FILING under 17 U.S.C. Section 105.
root_cause: Conflation of public accessibility of regulatory filings with public domain status of privately drafted commercial agreements.
remediation: Corrected legal status to PUBLICLY_ACCESSIBLE_RIGHTS_UNDETERMINED; prohibited complete contract redistribution.

description: Discourse inversion (P1) targeted markers ('Notwithstanding the foregoing') whose antecedents were internal to the segmented clause.
root_cause: Oracle assumed backward discourse markers always refer to preceding segmented clauses without checking intra-clause sentence position.
remediation: Audited all 28 positive cases, classified P1 as INVALID_TRANSFORMATION, and produced post-hoc sensitivity analysis.

description: Clause records in memory were instantiated with default doc_id='unknown', causing clause IDs to be named 'unknown_14'.
root_cause: Omission of doc_id parameter when calling segmenter.segment(raw_text) in dataset_builder.py.
remediation: Identified in dataset_denominator_audit.md; parent document ID is preserved in parent_document_id field.

description: Candidate C2 reported as complete underfitting (TP=0, FP=0, FN=2, TN=16) in narrative reports and metric_consistency_results.json, while raw CSV rows produced TP=2, FP=16, FN=0, TN=0 due to uncalibrated sigmoid output (~0.523) exceeding 0.50 threshold.
root_cause: Uncalibrated sigmoid head crossed arbitrary 0.50 threshold while narrative summaries reported intended underfitting behavior.
remediation: Reconciled both representations in corrected_metric_consistency.json and posthoc_sensitivity_analysis.md; asserted both in regression tests and handled undefined precision/F1 as NOT_ESTIMABLE.

description: Phase 4D-C report conflated 10 metadata keys in edgar_manifest.json with filings and cited 183 passed baseline instead of 193 passed (185 to 195 collected).
root_cause: Auditor evaluated len(data) of manifest dictionary and carried forward Phase 4D-B test count.
remediation: Documented true inventory (50 entries, 19 accessions, 19 CIKs, 50 files, 32 parents) and verified 193 passed in raw pytest log.
